thread:
alyssa: Heads up — seeing a cluster of fncall schema rejects but Console is showing them as billed tool runs. small sample below.

alyssa: ```json
{
  "tool_call": {
    "name": "lookup",
    "args": ["item_123"]
  }
}
```

jamal: what's the validator error?

alyssa: validator -> type_mismatch at /tool_call/args: expected object but got array

rachel: if args is wrong the adapter never executes. current billing flow counts the root invoke immediately and later the adapter flips a tag when it runs, so if adapter never runs attribution looks like a charged tool call.

jamal: policy question: bill or not? my vote: don't bill when validation fails before adapter. but we need an audit-safe, deterministic tag so it can't be spoofed.

rachel: suggestion: emit internal metadata: `route.meta.validation_outcome=reject_pre_adapter`, `route.meta.validation_rule=shape_mismatch`, and set `route.meta.billing_executed=false` for those requests. record a sampled payload id for audit.

alyssa: Console UX should display "Validation reject — no tool run" (orange) with link to raw payload sample id. Ops is waking up to cost spikes right now.

jamal: rollout plan: 1) add internal tags and metric `validation.reject_pre_adapter.count` 2) canary 3% traffic with billing_hold runtime flag 3) sample payloads for 14d 4) monitor for abuse signals and cost delta for 2 weeks then decide.

rachel: implementation note: do NOT add public API fields. keep everything under internal `route.meta.*`. add unit & e2e tests that simulate adapter not invoked and assert `billing.tool_executed=false` (cover streaming + partial-parse cases).

alyssa: also want a Console alert: if validation_reject rate rises >50% in 1h AND billed tool-run cost increases in same window, auto-create a triage card listing top affected routes and sample ids.

billing-bot: deploy: initiating canary `fncall-preval-billing-hold` -> eng-runtime-canary (3%). CI: all tests passed, 1 flaky infra warning. :rocket:

jamal: I'll open the PR for telemetry + runtime flag and add a metric `validation.reject_pre_adapter.sampled`.

rachel: I'll draft the Console card mockup + support blurb and attach copy for KB. tagging @console-ui for visibility. :raised_hands:

alyssa: thanks all — feel better having a deterministic rule. will follow up on support notes and the audit sample job.
